B_certified_sfp.gate: must reach >= 0.95 on BOTH probe ROLE_TEST and probe NOVEL_TEST accuracy, otherwise the representation instrument is BLOCKED and the main trajectory is not run
B_certified_sfp.vector: frozen 009 Arm B code, 16 one-hot units per incidence presentation (S:2, FFF:7, PP:4, pp:3), summed over the two presentations; 16 dimensions

C_scrambled.role: diagnostic only, never a selection criterion
C_scrambled.vector: frozen 009 Arm C non-automorphic scramble, identical shape and matched field marginals, pooled identically; 16 dimensions

random_gaussian.role: diagnostic only, never a selection criterion
random_gaussian.vector: seeded standard Gaussian token vectors, 128 dimensions, torch.manual_seed(271828)

controls.secondary_declared_variant: the canonical-concatenation form of the Arm B and Arm C codes (32 dimensions) is additionally reported for transparency; the gate binds only to the summed primary declared above

form.features: f(a,b) = concat(z_a + z_b, z_a * z_b, abs(z_a - z_b))

metric_definitions.all_block_three_role_consistency: the same fraction over all 56 certified blocks
metric_definitions.canonical_certificate: when the decoded relation is exact, an exact canonical hypergraph certificate is computed; no preferred SFP coordinate labels are required
metric_definitions.full_56_block_relation_exact: true only when all three completions of all 56 blocks are correct
metric_definitions.seen_block_three_role_consistency: fraction of the 48 seen blocks whose three completions are all answered correctly

purpose: fixed direct representation readout: a fresh shared decoder trained only on TRAIN, applied to frozen main-model token representations
representation: z_x = concat(input_embedding[x], candidate_embedding[x]); 128 dimensions; the main model's pair trunk and candidate bias are discarded for this diagnostic

rules.initialization: Xavier uniform gain 1.0 on weights, zero biases

width_adaptation: only the input projection width and the candidate projection input width follow the control-vector dimension; hidden width stays 64 and the semantic form is unchanged
